purpose: The context of use of the Kim 2026 lenalidomide model on the platform, as enforceable rules. Written from results already on record; no new computation. Policy chosen by the platform owner on 30 October 2026: where the model was fitted on such patients but a locked outside check found it inconsistent, compute, flag and show the observed data (this keeps the 14 October decision that severe renal impairment is calculated and warned, not hidden); beyond the model's own data, refuse.

evidence_tiers.externally_checked: Inside a locked outside check whose primary result was consistent in every scenario.
evidence_tiers.inside_model_data: Inside the data the model was built on; the outside check's primary result here was not consistent in every scenario, or there was no check.
evidence_tiers.external_check_disagrees: Inside the model's data, but a locked outside check's primary result found the model inconsistent here: computed, flagged and shown with the observed data.

supported.label: Typical-value unbound and total concentration curves and exposure
supported.evidence: The model's own output for the record's estimated covariates; its evidence is the weakest tier among the rules that admitted the record.

not_supported.label: This patient's concentrations
not_supported.reason: Typical values only; between-patient variability is not shown and no measured concentrations are used.

request_rules.basis: Kim 2026 enrolled 30 Korean patients with multiple myeloma (model_extract study_population). The outside study's disease context is not established.

outside_reason.default: Kim 2026 enrolled only patients with multiple myeloma.
outside_reason.UNKNOWN: Disease not declared; cannot determine whether the record is inside the model's data.

tier_by_band.band_note: Mild group (creatinine clearance 50-80 mL/min): ratio to normal consistent in all seven scenarios; normal-group exposure consistent in six of seven (external_check_report). The study groups are defined by creatinine clearance; Kim's covariate is indexed eGFR, so band edges are approximate.

Moderate group (30-50 mL/min): ratio to normal consistent in the primary scenario but not in every scenario; absolute exposure under-predicted about 1.3-fold in six of seven (secondary endpoint) (external_check_report).

Severe group (< 30 mL/min): ratio to normal under-predicted about 1.3-fold in the primary scenario (five of seven scenarios); half-life reproduced (applicability_findings renal-under-prediction-severe). Read the curve as possibly somewhat low.

state_rules.basis: Kim's covariate is CKD-EPI 2021 indexed eGFR estimated from the record; model data 11.1-94.7 mL/min/1.73 m2 (model_extract ranges_table1).

outside_reason.below: Below the model's data (eGFR 11.1). The outside study observed much higher exposure in severe renal impairment (shown below).
outside_reason.above: Above the model's data (eGFR 94.7): Kim 2026 enrolled no patients with higher kidney function.

state_rules.basis: Du Bois BSA; model data 1.41-2.01 m2 (model_extract ranges_table1).

outside_reason.default: Body surface area outside the model's data.

state_rules.basis: Model data 3.0-5.2 g/dL (= 30-52 g/L); albumin is not a model input, so an unknown value is not assessed rather than blocking.

outside_reason.default: Albumin outside the model's data (protein binding may differ; the model assumes a constant unbound fraction).

enforced_elsewhere: Doses (5, 7.5 or 10 mg), schedule (24 h intervals, at most four doses) and horizon are checked by the existing calculation (execution blockers).
unknown_policy: A rule whose input is unknown cannot be evaluated; the record is then 'cannot_determine' and no output is computed, except rules marked optional, which are reported as not assessed. Unknown stays unknown.
never_claimed: A prediction for a real patient, a dose recommendation or a judgement of treatment suitability.
Validation of the model; validation flags stay false.
